League-derived replacement level

Replacement level is recalculated from the imported Sleeper league: team count, starting slots, FLEX / SUPER_FLEX / IDP_FLEX requirements, bench size and the league's actual positional ownership. It therefore changes automatically from league to league.
Replacement adjustment strength
Bench depth influence
Actual ownership influence
VOR = a player's Model Score minus the league-specific replacement baseline at his position. A positive VOR means he grades above the estimated replacement player in this league. The Target Score receives a variable positive or negative replacement adjustment based on that gap.

Prediction engines added in V5

Draft / seasonCurrent opportunity, league-scored prior production, PFF/TFG quality, depth-chart security, replacement value and team environment. Dynasty age/contract effects are deliberately lighter than in the acquisition model.
Waiver wireFree agents only by default. Role momentum, opportunity shock, teammate injuries, efficiency-vs-production buy-low signal, weekly outlook and dynasty Target Score.
Start / SitLeague-scored baseline PPG × projected role × opponent points allowed by position × team/game environment × live injury adjustment × weather/market context. Produces floor, mean, ceiling and a lineup recommendation.
UncertaintyRange widens for volatile positions, backups, injuries and low-evidence players. Risk preference can rank by floor, mean or ceiling.

Inputs still requiring an external source or user update

Official current injury/practice reportsnflverse currently has no post-2024 injury feed. V5 uses Sleeper injury fields. A stable official injury-report API/feed would improve status, practice participation and late-week projections.
Live bookmaker consensus / player propsnflverse schedules include lines when available. For fresher market data, paste a The Odds API key in the weekly controls. Player props would require an odds provider with prop coverage.
College production / athletic testingNeeded to materially improve rookie priors beyond draft capital + TFG + depth chart. Useful inputs: dominator/target share, YPRR, MTF/touch, breakout age and combine/pro-day testing.
Remaining TFG teamsBAL, BUF, DEN, DET, HOU, KC, LAR, PHI and SEA are still missing from the supplied workbook. V5 reweights rather than penalizing them.

Data status

SleeperLive league settings, roster ownership, depth metadata, player IDs and 24-hour trending adds.
nflverse PlayersPublic player identity table used for GSIS/PFR/OTC IDs plus draft year, round and pick.
OverTheCap via nflversePublic historical contract dataset. Active contract length, APY, guarantees and estimated expiry inform roster commitment and future openings.
nflverse 2025 StatsRegular + postseason player summary. Re-scored with the loaded league settings when recognizable stat fields are available.
PFR Snap Counts via nflverse2025 game-level offense/defense/special-teams snap shares, used as a role-volume and production-reliability signal.
PFF 2025Regular season + postseason. Position-specific performance score is percentile-based and shrunk toward league average when the sample is small.
TFG 2026Current uploaded “Deep Dive Numbers” workbook, matched across the full player pool. Missing teams and missing players are not penalized.
Depth chartsY1/Y2: curated opportunity board, snapshot 19 Aug 2026. Everyone else: live Sleeper depth_chart_order / depth_chart_position estimate. Treat preseason roles as provisional until final/official depth charts.
Current TFG gaps: BAL, BUF, DEN, DET, HOU, KC, LAR, PHI, SEA. When a new TFG workbook is supplied, these can be incorporated without changing the app's ranking logic.
V5 is a decision-support tool, not a projection system. “Target” is an acquisition-oriented score for the full active NFL universe after Sleeper loads, while “Model” is the intrinsic blended score before free-agent, trending and league-specific replacement-level adjustments. Curated Y1/Y2 opportunity grades override the automated Sleeper-depth estimate when available. PFF and TFG inputs are derived from the user-provided files. Sleeper data are read live from the public API. Weekly models can additionally pull nflverse schedules/stats/snaps/depth charts, Open-Meteo weather and optional bookmaker consensus.
